title: Zebra prepares for shorter blocks
text:
OPENZCASH
MONTHLY
ORGANIZATIONS
02
Zebra prepares for shorter blocks
Stable 7.0.0 · October 21 in São Paulo / October 22 UTC
ZCASH FOUNDATION
ZEBRA + CORE STACK
01
NU7-ready stable release
Zebra 7.0.0 prepares Mainnet for activation at block 3,543,405 in early November.
02
Reliable synchronization
Peer selection, block retries and resource limits address failures near the chain tip.
03
Andale remains a prerelease
7.1.0-alpha.0 targets validation speed. Published benchmarks are workload-specific.
04
Leadership transition
David Campbell was named Executive Director; the handover extends into
January.

title: Two research paths beyond NU7
text:
OPENZCASH
MONTHLY
ORGANIZATIONS
03
Two research paths beyond NU7
October work · Crosslink feature network and Epoch research
SHIELDED LABS
FINALITY + CRYPTOGRAPHY
01
Crosslink network restarted
The October 1 feature-network restart exercised BFT bootstrap and validator
commissions.
02
Consensus fixes under test
Version 15 addressed proposal stalls, commission issuance and voting-power
changes.
03
Epoch research programme
A new team is researching future-proof cryptography, with an end-2027 target.
04
Research is not activation
Crosslink tests and dynamic-fee drafts do not change Zcash Mainnet consensus.

title: Specification work moves into proof tooling
text:
OPENZCASH
MONTHLY
ORGANIZATIONS
04
Specification work moves into proof tooling
October repository changes · development, not a Mainnet release
TACHYON
SCALING + PROOF SYSTEMS
01
Evidence-tree specification
October changes refine evidence trees and the anchor-span model used by the
design.
02
Fee design and domain separation
The repository adds a dynamic-fee mechanism and revises cryptographic domain
strings.
03
Ragu verification work
Verifier fingerprints, proof obligations and fixture coverage advanced during
October.
04
Deployment remains a separate step
These commits show implementation work; they do not establish an activated
upgrade.

title: A smaller node, with more checks
text:
OPENZCASH
MONTHLY
ORGANIZATIONS
05
A smaller node, with more checks
October recap published November 1 · release and audit sources cross-checked
ZAKURA
NODE + WALLET LIBRARIES
01
Stable 1.7.0 prepares NU7
Released October 22; fork-choice, mempool and block-relay changes target
network health.
02
Dependencies cut from 598 to 197
The team reports a smaller build and 83.2% mining-hashrate adoption at month
end.
03
Verification put under attack
zkSecurity tested the Ironwood formalization; CPU/compiler diversity adds
another check.
04
Privacy work, with clear limits
PIR expanded; quantum-unlinkable swaps are integrated but not deployed. P2Pv2
is experimental.

title: Hardware signing reaches more wallets
text:
OPENZCASH
MONTHLY
HARDWARE
07
Hardware signing reaches more wallets
October integrations · software support and device prototypes are distinct
ZODL + Ledger
ZODL 3.17 introduced Ledger integration. Users review and
sign on the hardware device.
Ledger app 3.10.0
Zakura reports optimization of transaction preparation,
roughly 10 to 5 seconds in its measurements.
Vizor migration support
Vizor 0.0.63 supports Ledger migration to Ironwood and
pauses transactions around activation.
LeekWallet prototype
An ESP32-S3 signing device was demonstrated October 30.
The host builds proofs; this is an early prototype.

title: The supporting stack keeps moving
text:
OPENZCASH
MONTHLY
DEVELOPMENT
08
The supporting stack keeps moving
Libraries, infrastructure and verification · delivery states remain separate
Core libraries + lightwalletd
Arborist updates covered NU7 prereleases, PCZT signing
work and lightwalletd reliability fixes.
Zallet and Zaino
NU7 integration continued. Zallet temporarily removed its
Zaino backend; no new stable release is inferred.
Zcash Shielded Assets
QEDIT reported catch-up work with recent upgrades.
Upstream integration and activation remain separate.
Source-linked Equihash proof
A Lean verification project was published October 31. Its
claims apply to the specified verifier and model.

title: New products invite real-world testing
text:
OPENZCASH
MONTHLY
PRODUCTS
09
New products invite real-world testing
Public October releases and demos · these are not independent security endorsements
Zafe multisig
An Android shielded-multisig beta was announced October
30. The team says no external audit yet.
ZecLearn
A browser quiz supports English and Turkish, QR entry and
shared rooms without signup.
Testnet faucet CLI
A new faucet uses proof of work to distribute testnet TAZ.
These are test coins, not spendable ZEC.
Can I Shield?
A public readiness checklist and NU7 countdown help track
wallet support ahead of activation.

title: Delivery, decisions and the next step
text:
OPENZCASH
MONTHLY
HIGHLIGHTS
10
Delivery, decisions and the next step
October close · the funding record continues in Operations
NU7 is prepared, not yet active
Node and wallet releases are readying the November transition.
Activation is tied to block 3,543,405.
Security evidence needs its scope
Formal audits, compiler diversity and proofs add checks. Benchmarks and
experimental features keep their labels.
A decade, and the next funding round
Zcon7 and the tenth anniversary marked October. Coinholder Q4
submissions opened; voting follows in December.
